title: Cephalopod tHg standard may miss EU 2023/915 300 ug/kg (strictest government ML)
repro: cat1-compiled/cephalopods.json builds the cephalopod mercury standard from India FSSAI, Paraguay, Mercosur and Guyana caps at 500 ug/kg plus a MeHg read-across, labeled no government sets a cephalopod-specific ML. But EU 2023/915 Annex I 3.3.1.3 places cephalopods and marine gastropods in the lower-mercury 0.30 mg/kg tier (300 ug/kg, animal without viscera), confirmed against primary text. Under Method v2.0 (strictest credible government ML) EU 300 should bind or be explicitly excluded with rationale. The Cat-6 cephalopod standard is live on heavymetalcertified, so a published cert tHg value may be too loose.
acceptance_criteria: Cephalopod tHg standard evaluates EU 2023/915 3.3.1.3 (300 ug/kg) as a candidate binding value

title: Verify+fix the ~97 registered-DOI-with-title-mismatch source pages (DOI resolves but to a different paper)
repro: The 2026-07-29 audit Section B lists ~97 source pages whose DOI RESOLVES but whose registered title differs from the page title. Many are benign (translated/paraphrased titles for the same paper), but some are genuine wrong-DOI mis-attributions where the DOI points to a completely different paper (e.g. onyegeme-okerenta2023-shellfish -> a triclosan/infertility paper; ortiz-garcia2023-arsenic-maternal -> an HPV-vaccination paper; flyvholm1984-nickel -> a German pesticide-photochemistry paper). This is the more dangerous, INVISIBLE cousin of the non-resolving-DOI class just cleared: the citation looks fine until a reviewer clicks through. Two live examples surfaced during the 2026-08-09 dedup and were EXCLUDED from the collapse: romero-crespo2023-ecuador-mining-crops-metals (title Heavy metals in soils and crops in a mining area of Ecuador vs registered Trace elements in farmland soils and crops...) and carignan2015-arsenic-infancy-well-water-breast-milk (actually the Schmidt commentary, real DOI 10.1289/ehp.123-a137).
acceptance_criteria: For each Section-B page: fetch the registered title via DOI content-negotiation, classify benign-translation vs genuine-mis-attribution
Genuine mis-attributions: recover the correct DOI via Crossref title search (handle-API 1 + exact title) or set no_doi_assigned:true + access_url
